jaguar.name: Jaguar
jaguar.description: The largest cat in the Americas, known for its beautiful spotted coat and powerful bite.

parrot.name: Parrot
parrot.description: Parrots are incredibly intelligent and some can even mimic human speech, with certain species knowing hundreds of words!

crocodile.name: Crocodile
crocodile.description: Crocodiles are large aquatic reptiles that live throughout the tropics. They are powerful predators with incredibly strong jaws.

heron.name: Heron
heron.description: Herons are long-legged, long-necked, freshwater and coastal birds known for their graceful hunting along water edges.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.description: Elephants are the largest existing land animals, distinguished by their long trunks, tusks, and large ear flaps.

goose.name: Goose
goose.description: Geese are waterfowl known for their distinctive honking sounds and for flying in a V-formation during migration.
